notes.title: What is the Graft?
notes.notes:
A half machine, half organic boat. The Graft wont stop at anything until it finds us.

He may want to hurt us or may be just curious, its not clear. But wherever the case we can't let it come close.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723062/1006679c14a55f76a964c38dfad96c8b533c5dbb.png[/img]
[i]The first sight of the creature, digitally enhanced image[/i]

This kind of boat really exists. It functions as an aquatic bus, moving people from place to place all around the delta. It's a Very powerful machine, capable of an amazing speed going forwards or backwards. The engine sounds like the roar of a wild animal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723062/13ec2510e0b97827e266abad00015ea417bd3f37.jpg[/img]
[i]Picture taken from the safety of the coast[/i]

notes.title: Real life Delta Kayak
notes.notes:
Did you know that Delta Kayak is based on a real place?

In Argentina, South America, where the Paraná river meets the Atlantic ocean, exists a maze of rivers and streams. It's one of the biggest deltas in the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723062/a290220f1ae3b8dedd0a4dee54f46f600fb9857a.jpg[/img]

Islanders live in houses suspended on stilts, water level can get very high some times.

It's a nice place to explore, full of stranded ships and stories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723062/09076dbece8c52637686b4984e27a12256a71890.jpg[/img]

The enemy boat is also based on a real public transport from the zone, but I will talk about it in a future newsletter.

notes.title: Datamosh image distortion fix
notes.notes:
Screen filters are fun, but not when you can't see [b]anything at all[/b]!

There was a small bug in the "damage effect", also called [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Compression_artifact#Artistic_use]datamosh[/url], that erased the entire image of the screen. That wasn't intentional!

Since the issue only appeared for some players, and I'm not sure if its fixed for everyone I've temporarily disabled it.

For the brave ones I've added an option to re enable it in the "Game Settings" menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723062/508fdb60723c781691ddaf1d1b0bee239456a968.png[/img]

notes.title: Welcome!!
notes.notes:
Welcome! My name is Eibriel, and I'm the developer of Delta Kayak.

The game is inspired in my experiences Kayaking on the Paraná river a long time ago. Plus some extra juice.

I'll be posting regular updates here, follow and wishlist to get notified!
